title: First Mobile Care Clinic Outreach
description: Our founder, Senator Dennis G. Rodriguez Jr., organizes the first outreach at Paradise Fitness in Hagåtña. Over 100 patients receive no-cost healthcare services with volunteer medical staff.
alt: First Mobile Care Clinic outreach at Paradise Fitness

title: Expanding Community Outreaches
description: The Mobile Care Clinic provides ongoing assistance to Guam's underserved residents through additional community events, reaching over 500 patients.
alt: Mobile Care Clinic serving community members

title: Official 501(c)(3) Nonprofit Registration
description: Our Board of Directors is officially formed, and Todu Guam Foundation registers as a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization.
alt: Todu Guam Foundation Board of Directors formation

title: First Health Prevention & Education Event
description: Our inaugural lay forum hosts over 200 attendees featuring Dr. Evan Vista (rheumatologist) and Dr. Maria Deanna Ramiscal (dermatologist).
alt: Health Prevention and Education lay forum event

title: Dededo Medical Outreach
description: Basic healthcare services are delivered to 300 patients during a targeted outreach event at Asahi Abai in Dededo.
alt: Medical outreach at Asahi Abai in Dededo

title: Health Prevention & Education
description: Over 200 people attend the lay forum featuring Dr. Evan Vista (a rheumatologist) and Dr. Maria Deanna Ramiscal (a dermatologist).

title: Volunteer Growth & Continuous Care
description: Medical outreaches expand island-wide. As volunteer recruitment climbs, our organizational capacity grows to serve more families.
alt: Todu Guam Foundation volunteers assisting patients

title: COVID-19 Patient Navigation & Relief
description: In response to the pandemic, we launch our Patient Navigation and Financial Assistance Program, delivering vital goods, medical care, and back-to-school physical vouchers.
alt: Patient Navigation and Financial Assistance distribution

title: Sustained Navigation & Support
description: Continued execution of the Patient Navigation and Financial Assistance Program to assist residents experiencing economic and health hardships.

title: CARES Movement Launch & 5,000+ Milestone
description: We launch the CARES Movement across GDOE schools to foster youth resiliency. Total patients served through the Mobile Care Clinic surpasses 5,000.
alt: CARES Movement rollout in Guam schools
